title: Medium's new TK app brings AI assistance directly into the writing process | TechCrunch
summary: Online publishing platform Medium on Monday launched a new app, called TK, which aims to bring AI technology deeper into the writing process. Medium, which is profitable, says TK will be a free tool for those with a Medium account.
